pr_metadata.title: [Chart] Fix rendering condition of "git_sync_ssh_key_volume"
pr_metadata.description:
## Issue
The `pod-template-file.kubernetes-helm-yaml` file provided as the default pod-template is missing a rendering condition for `git_sync_ssh_key_volume` when the SSH key is directly specified in the values (as opposed to using a secret reference).

## Changes
This PR adds the missing condition to properly render the git sync SSH key volume in this use case.

gold_comments.issue_summary: Let's split this test into two test cases based on the settings (`sshKeySecret` or `sshKey`) that we set. It will be more readable, and in general, there should be no logic in tests
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The test `test_pod_template_git_sync_ssh_key_volume` uses a single parametrized method with six test cases covering different combinations of `sshKeySecret` and `sshKey`, contrary to the reviewer's suggestion to split into separate tests.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would leave this comment to improve test maintainability and clarity by separating test concerns into distinct test methods rather than using a single parametrized test with mixed scenarios.
